rawContent: Wait, everywhere I go there are pride flags and pride tees on employees, on public bridges, in bath & body works, Macy's, etc. It's everywhere all the time. And that is FINE, but why not the same protections for #BlackLivesMatter apparel, flags, etc.

Exactly. I fell for it as did many journos. The movements like #MeToo are necessary and valuable. But, men are entitled to not be presumed guilty and ruined without a trial by judge and jury. All of us should be. Facts matter.
